items.name: PBQ Toledo 2025
items.information: This competition takes place on a Monday night and features blindfolded events only! This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many other competitions happening in [Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Ohio) or [Michigan](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Michigan). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
